items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 13 at 9:45AM EST until November 13 at 1:00PM EST by NWS State College PA
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations up to one inch.

* WHERE...Northern Lycoming, Sullivan, and Tioga Counties.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM EST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Be prepared for winter driving conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snowfall will be elevation-dependent with
accumulation most likely above 1500 feet. Snow is most likely to
accumulate on non-paved surfaces.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit www.511pa.com for
the latest travel, roadways, and traffic conditions.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 13 at 3:04AM EST until November 13 at 3:00PM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.areaDesc: Atlantic; Cape May; Atlantic Coastal Cape May; Coastal Atlantic; Southeastern Burlington
items.description:
* WHAT...One to two feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Atlantic, Cape May, Atlantic Coastal Cape May, Coastal
Atlantic and Southeastern Burlington.

* WHEN...From 9 AM this morning to 3 PM EST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At this level, widespread roadway flooding occurs in
coastal and bayside communities and along inland tidal
waterways. Many roads become impassable. Some damage to
vulnerable structures may begin to occur. At this level,
flooding begins on the most vulnerable roads in coastal and
bayside communities, and along inland tidal waterways. Some
partial or full road closures are possible.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that minor tidal flooding is
expected. Minor tidal flooding often results in some road
closures. Usually, the most vulnerable roadways will flood.

Do not leave your vehicle at a location that is prone to tidal
flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flood waters. The
water may be deeper than you think it is. You will be putting
yourself in danger and your vehicle may be damaged, leading to
costly repairs.

Visit the National Water Prediction Service at
https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/phi for additional water level and
flood impact information for your local tide gauge.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 13 at 3:04AM EST until November 13 at 3:00PM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.description:
* WHAT...One to two feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Ocean and Coastal Ocean.

* WHEN...From 9 AM this morning to 3 PM EST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At this level, widespread roadway flooding occurs in
coastal and bayside communities and along inland tidal
waterways. Many roads become impassable. Some damage to
vulnerable structures may begin to occur.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Warning means that moderate or major tidal
flooding is occurring or imminent. Be prepared for rising water
levels and take appropriate action to protect life and property.
Follow the recommendations of local emergency management
officials.

Do not drive your vehicle through flood waters. The water may be
deeper than you think it is. You will be putting yourself in
danger and your vehicle may be damaged, leading to costly
repairs.

Visit the National Water Prediction Service at
https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/phi for additional water level and
flood impact information for your local tide gauge.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued November 13 at 1:06AM EST until November 13 at 6:00PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways (3.2 to 11.6 feet Mean Lower Low Water).

* WHERE...Barnstable MA and Nantucket MA Counties.

* WHEN...Friday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Roads remain passable. Low lying areas and roads
near Nantucket Harbor, including Easy Street, may experience
pockets of shallow flooding less than one foot deep.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Splashover and very minor coastal
flooding are possible during the Friday afternoon high tide
along north facing beaches on Cape Cod Bay as well as
Nantucket sound. No significant impacts are expected and any
splashover/very minor coastal flooding will be quite short-
lived, no more than an hour on either side of high tide.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued November 13 at 4:30AM EST until November 13 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Upton NY
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to half a foot of inundation above ground level
expected in vulnerable areas near the waterfront and shoreline.

* WHERE...Southern Fairfield County.

* WHEN...From noon today to 4 PM EST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Isolated minor flooding in the more
vulnerable locations near the waterfront and shoreline.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
